content: You're not doing anything wrong. Your intention is to spare your dad additional unnecessary heartache, and managing his grief and confusion is a compassionate approach in this context. The sister's stance on always telling the truth, while understandable, may not take into account the emotional toll of repeatedly facing the painful reality of the loss on someone with moderate dementia who can't process or forget it. Your approach acknowledges his reality as gently as possible while protecting him from the repeated trauma of the grief. Continue what you're doing; your actions demonstrate care and empathy.
